name: tutorial-previous-run
title: Previous Run Outputs
description: Round-trips a message between runs: a script step reads `previousRun.message` from /output/previous_run.json, a human step sets the message the next run will see. Demonstrates the inputForNextRun carry-over contract and the empty-object first-run case.

steps.name: Set message for next run
steps.description: Type a message in the form below. The next run of this workflow will see it as `previousRun.message`.

params.name: message
params.description: Message to pass to the next run.
